DiagnosticReport.conclusion:
1. No acute traumatic injury in the abdomen or pelvis.
2. Lower anterior abdominal wall contusion.
3. 3.4 cm right adnexal cyst with a thin internal septation. Recommend nonemergent pelvic ultrasound for further characterization.

_sections.title: EXAM
_sections.text: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH INTRAVENOUS CONTRAST

_sections.title: CLINICAL INDICATION
_sections.text: Motor vehicle collision, restrained driver, airbag deployment. Lower abdominal pain and seatbelt mark. Evaluate for traumatic injury.

_sections.title: TECHNIQUE
_sections.text: Helical CT of the abdomen and pelvis in the portal venous phase after intravenous administration of 100 mL iohexol 350. Coronal and sagittal reformats were reviewed. CTDIvol: 11.2 mGy. DLP: 548 mGy-cm.

items.label: Lower chest
items.text: Lung bases are clear. No pneumothorax.

items.label: Solid organs
items.text: No laceration or hematoma of the liver, spleen, pancreas, kidneys, or adrenal glands.

items.label: Bowel and mesentery
items.text: No bowel wall thickening, mesenteric hematoma, or free air.

items.label: Pelvic organs
items.text: The uterus is normal. 3.4 cm cystic lesion of the right ovary with a single thin internal septation; no solid component or mural nodularity. The left ovary is normal with physiologic follicles. The bladder is unremarkable.

items.label: Soft tissues
items.text: Mild subcutaneous stranding of the lower anterior abdominal wall, consistent with seatbelt contusion.
